extraction_note: EXTRACTED, NOT COPIED AS SETTLED. The code is extracted from the first draft's shipped scene (files/short-soa01-renters-v3-scene.html, sha256 8a84c408d7bf9bec069604774e4a1361dd69047ccc465d8a157fa69563f07743, 7,318,714 B) and is byte-identical to it at this phase. What was extracted: the whole engine and compartment set — container, six per-line compartments, bridge, word-animation layer, audio compartment, decision layer, chrome. Why extraction is the honest move here: phase 2 decided the compartment inventory FROM THE ARCHITECTURE first, and the extracted scene was then verified against that inventory element-by-element (the inventory below, checked against the file's DOM ids and its own decision records) — every decided compartment exists, and no compartment exists that the architecture did not decide. What was changed at this phase: NOTHING in the code. What changes around the code in this branch: (1) authority — the branch's decisions/ files (phase 5) are the record of authority; the in-scene blocks ride as the scene's carriage of the same records; (2) the audio the scene embeds for standalone preview is the first draft's guide-era programme audio — this branch's decided narration is the clone programme audio recorded in audio/ (phase 6), and the render derivative pairs the scene with it (the first draft's own DR-AUDIO ladder did exactly this); (3) phase 7 splices the editability layer into this file. If a future decision changes any compartment, it changes here by commit and the inventory below is updated in the same commit.

editability.what: The in-scene editor layer (pattern: hidden_files/finishing/soa-01/editability/PATTERN.md — inspect an object → edit its OWNED data → save → reopen → the rendered change appears, with the reasoning layer linked to the outcome). Modes: ?render = fully inert; no flag = a saved overlay applies before the first frame; ?edit=1 = the editor UI opens (click a word span or its list row → inspector shows its decision record beside the form; edit cx/cy/key/start/end + treatment/effect per word, on/off per element; Save writes a sparse diff to localStorage key 'soa-01-edits-v1'; Export produces package-shaped word-decisions.json + plan-edits.json for commit-back).
